# Capacity Plus and Linked Capacity Plus PDUs that dmrgo decoded from public recordings, with valid CRCs. Only the decoder output is here, not the recordings.
# lcp: baseband I/Q of a Linked Capacity Plus rest beacon, site 3, CC 12, attached to sdrtrunk issue 1947 (github.com/DSheirer/sdrtrunk/issues/1947).
# busy: DMRMOTOTRBO_Sound.mp3 of the Signal Identification Wiki DMR page (sigidwiki.com/wiki/Digital_Mobile_Radio_(DMR)), a busy single site Capacity Plus repeater, CC 1, from the inverted audio.
# rest: Possible_MOTOTRBO_DMR_resting_burst.mp3 of the same page, a Linked Capacity Plus rest beacon, site 4, CC 1, from the inverted audio.
# halifax: 451.4875MHz.wav of the same page, Capacity Plus with a call on TG 30, CC 2; a SYNC-trained slicer and layer2/framer.
# revert: DMR.mp3 of the same page, MOTOTRBO enhanced data revert, CC 8.
# Columns: the recording, the PDU kind (csbk: 12 octets, slc: the 5 octets of a Short LC), the octets.
